search_text:
曲线 $x=a\cos^3t,y=a\sin^3t$（$0\le t\le2\pi$）围成图形的面积。 $\frac38\pi a^3$ $\frac38\pi a^2$ $-\frac38\pi a^2$ $\frac37\pi a^2$ 解

$$
\begin{aligned}
A&=\frac{1}{2}\oint_Lx\,\mathrm{d}y-y\,\mathrm{d}x
=\frac{1}{2}\times4\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left[a\cos^3t\cdot3a\sin^2t\cos t-a\sin^3t\cdot3a\cos^2t(-\sin t)\right]\,\mathrm{d}t\\
&=6a^2\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left[\cos^4t\sin^2t+\sin^4t\cos^2t\right]\,\mathrm{d}t
=6a^2\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos^2t\sin^2t\,\mathrm{d}t
=\frac{3}{8}\pi a^2。
\end{aligned}
$$
